correctness.rationale: Exact reduction to five projected points; uniqueness/reflection restricts smallest-circle center to one coordinate, and elementary minimax balance yields two exact branches. Concavity of D(a)=h sqrt(1-a²)+a shows all minima in edge-midpoint planes occur at only a=0 or a=sqrt((h²-1)/(h²+1)), whose squared-radii equality factors as (h²-1)(h⁴-4h²-1)=0. In diagonal mirror planes the base diagonal projects isometrically, forcing radius >=sqrt2 and excluding them. D derivative gives local onset sqrt2, algebraic comparison gives global threshold sqrt(2+sqrt5), and branch derivatives differ. Standalone checker passed 38,936 independent finite MEC/grid assertions; finite tests do not replace analytic proof.
